lines: (Bramble pops up out of the ground right in front of you, petals in her hair.) There you are! The whole hive's still humming about you.
I've been thinking. Rooting, mostly, but thinking too. Can I come with you? Wherever you go, I'll be right behind you. Or right under you!
And when there's soft ground and you need to get somewhere quick, press {burrow} and we'll burrow together.
Yay! I'll be right behind you. Press {friend} any time you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Still want me along? I'm ready when you are!
Yay! I'll be right behind you. Press {friend} any time you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
{player}! Pip says you can glow now, like a little lantern! Oh, that's PERFECT.
Under my garden there are caves. The Undergardens. My roots go all the way down, but I've never seen them, it's too dark. Snappy won't go near.
The way in is the Rootwell, the root-ringed hole on top of the hill, west of the greenhouse. It's been tangled shut, but the roots will let a light in.
Something big has been snoring down there ever since the Void cracked. The plants say it's the Old Taproot. Could you go and see?
How are the Undergardens? The roots say you're stomping about down there. Nicely, though.
Four Glowcap spores, the plants whisper. In the Root Hall, the Mushroom Grotto, the Crystal Pool and the Deep Crack.
The Old Taproot is AWAKE? He's every plant on this hill's great-great-great-grandroot! And he gave you Glowcaps!
Plant them up here and they'll glow all night. My garden's going to look like a little bit of the sky.
The old slide? Ooh. The plants round it don't like to talk about it.
Nothing grows near it any more, and at night there's a little green glow by the Haunted House.
The oldest roots in the woods remember something getting STUCK in that house, a long time ago. Something that liked to slide.
Rights for dogs? Of course! Rook dug up my whole carrot patch last week, and I still love him. The carrots forgave him too.
(Bramble signs with a big loopy B and a little leaf. Snappy tries to eat the pen.)
{player}! Down here! Well, up here now. (Bramble pops out of the ground by the portal.) I've been waiting so long a butterfly landed on my antlers.
The south meadow is blooming tonight. Moonflowers, starbells, the lot. The roots told me. You have to see it!
And something's out there that isn't a flower. A glowy blue paper, blown in from who knows where. A schematic, Dash calls it.
It's over on the lake side of the meadow. Zippy will want to see it.
Oh! And Zippy's been asking who wants to race. Grow fast and you might win something!
(The ground in front of you bulges... and a girl made of leaves pops up, showering soil everywhere.) Oh! Hello! Sorry about the dirt.
I'm Bramble. I grow things, and I fix up anybody who's feeling poorly. And this is Snappy.
(The flytrap on her arm opens wide and goes SNAP!)
Snappy, manners! Sorry! He's friendly, really. He only eats bugs. And sometimes socks.
{player}: Like a doctor?
Sort of! More like a garden that gives hugs. I travel underground, it's quicker, and the worms give very good directions.
Guess who asked me for flowers? Mr. Palmer himself! He said Rex's campaign gave him the idea.
Flowers in every window box in town. I've got the bundles all tied up, but I can't carry them underground. They'd get muddy.
Would you fill the boxes for me?
Hooray! Here you go, a whole armful.
(Bramble hands {player} a big bundle of flowers. They smell like sunshine.)
Mr. Palmer's window at the Town Hall, Nina's house, the Potion Shop, the Book Store, and Dash's place.
No rush! Flowers don't mind waiting in a bucket.
How are the window boxes coming? Each one needs a little love.
Mr. Palmer's, Nina's, the Potion Shop, the Book Store and Dash's.
{player}: All the window boxes are full, Bramble!
I know! I could feel them blooming from here. All the way down in my roots.
You know what? I had a few bundles left over. So I popped up round town and did the rest of the town too.
(Bramble winks. Snappy winks too, sort of.)
A town with flowers is a town that smiles. Thank you!
Every window in town's got flowers now. I pop up and water them on my morning walk. Well, morning burrow.
The bees are having the best week of their lives.
{player}: Bramble, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
Ooh, he asked about me? That's so sweet!
Flowers. Flowers in every window box in town. A town with flowers is a town that smiles.
You tell that pup I said so. Kindly.
{player}, have you seen the glowing green crystals round the Void? Up by the castle, out in the woods, on the lake shore?
They're Remnants. Sparkles that got squeezed together for ages and ages, until they turned into crystal. They grow in the ground like roots. Roots of time!
Nobody can dig them out by hand. But plants can hear them humming, and so can I. With the right tool, I could coax some out for you.
And while we're digging... there's a patch of ground in the Secret Gardens, right in front of my greenhouse, that's just BEGGING to be your garden.
Hooray! We need three things. A rootwood handle: the old roots in the Secret Gardens drop one now and then.
A moonshell scoop. They wash up by the dock, near the portal.
And a hum crystal, from the Observatory hill. Hold it near the ground and it buzzes. Bring them all to me!
That's all right. Remnants are very patient. They've been waiting since forever.
The Remnants were humming again last night. I think they want to meet you. Shall we make that harvesting tool?
Yay! A rootwood handle from the Secret Gardens, a moonshell scoop from by the dock, and a hum crystal from the Observatory hill. Bring them to me!
Okay! Snappy says no rush. (Snappy says nothing. He's asleep.)

rotate: How's the hunt going? You've found {parts_found} of the three.
The handle's in the Secret Gardens, the scoop's by the dock, and the hum crystal's up on the Observatory hill. They glow a little, so look for a light.
(Bramble presses her ear to the ground.) The roots say the parts are still out there. They're very chatty today.

lines: {player}: I found all three parts!
You did! Let me see... handle, scoop, crystal. Oh, the crystal's humming like mad. It's excited!
(Bramble winds a vine round the handle, tucks the crystal in, and Snappy holds the scoop very still. Mostly still.)
Now, what should it look like? It's your tool, so you choose!
(She tucks fresh leaves all round it. It's a Leafy Trowel!)
(She sets little crystals all along the handle. It's a Crystal Pick!)
(She twists a vine into a star at the end. It's a Star Scoop!)
There! Your very own {tool}. Now find a glowing vein, there's one on the lake shore, and use it there.
I'll hear the crystals humming and pop up to help. I'm very quick underground!
Off you go! Any glowing vein will do. The one on the lake shore is closest. I'll be right there, I promise. Probably under your feet.
There you are! Welcome to your garden. Well, it will be.
Six beds, a fence, a barrel of rainwater. Everything a little plant could want.
Pop a seed in one of the dug beds, then give it some water. A plant without water just waits. Very politely.

rotate: Is it growing? If it's drooping with a little water drop over it, it's thirsty. Give it a drink and off it goes again!
Blinkberries are the quickest. A Goggle Gourd takes ages, but it's SO worth it. And the Remnant sprout grows a whole Void day!
How's your garden? The plants told me it's their favourite on the whole hill. Don't tell the greenhouse.
The veins have grown back, I can hear them. Just use your {tool} on one and I'll pop up!
The Fruit stall in the Market buys your crops. And the Sweets stall makes them into snacks! Blinkberry tart is my favourite. Snappy likes the fries.

lines: The portal's open! The flowers by it glow brighter every time. Isn't that something?
Morning! I wiggle my roots in, and everything grows a little happier.
(Bramble whispers something to a carrot.)
He says hi! Roots are like friends. You can't always see them, but they're the ones holding you up.
Fresh flowers! I grew every single one of them myself. Some of them are my cousins.
(Bramble tucks a little pink flower behind {player}'s ear.)
There. Pretty as a picture.
Want to see how I get about? Watch the ground!
(She dives into the soil with a little twirl and pops up a few steps away.) Ta-daa!
When I'm under there, everything's quiet and cosy. Then I come up and say hello to the sky again.
Watering time! Everybody gets a drink before bed, even the plants. Even me.
Morning! The flowers wake up the same time I do. We do our stretches together. Sunshine is my breakfast.
(Bramble stretches. A daisy nearby seems to stretch too.)
Shh, the plants are sleeping. We have to whisper so they grow nice and tall.
{player}: (whispering) Goodnight, plants.

rotate: (Snappy snaps at a passing firefly. Misses.) He's still learning. We all are!
You look a little tuckered out. Want a pick-me-up?

lines: (Bramble pats {player} on the head. Tiny flowers pop up around {their} feet.)
There you go! Fresh as a daisy.
Alright! Give the ground a knock if you need me.

rotate: Whenever I feel wobbly, I think about my roots. Deep down, nice and steady. You've got roots too, you know. Your friends. Your home.
Melody sings to my flowers every evening. I think they like the high notes best.
Here's to more brain breaks! Sit in the grass a minute. It helps, I promise.
